from collections import namedtuple
import json
from random import randint

# Curve parameters
Point = namedtuple("Point", "x y")
INFINITY = Point(None, None)

def is_infinity(P):
    return P == INFINITY

def check_point(P, curve):
    if is_infinity(P):
        return True
    x, y = P
    return (y * y - x * x * x - curve.a * x - curve.b) % curve.p == 0

def point_addition(P1, P2, curve):
    if is_infinity(P1):
        return P2
    elif is_infinity(P2):
        return P1

    x1, y1 = P1
    x2, y2 = P2

    if x1 == x2 and (y1 + y2) % curve.p == 0:
        return INFINITY

    if P1 == P2:
        if y1 == 0:
            return INFINITY
        m = (3 * x1 * x1 + curve.a) * pow(2 * y1, -1, curve.p)
    else:
        m = (y2 - y1) * pow(x2 - x1, -1, curve.p)

    m %= curve.p

    x3 = (m * m - x1 - x2) % curve.p
    y3 = (m * (x1 - x3) - y1) % curve.p

    return Point(x3, y3)

def double_and_add(P, n, curve):
    Q = INFINITY
    R = P

    while n > 0:
        if n & 1:
            Q = point_addition(Q, R, curve)
        R = point_addition(R, R, curve)
        n >>= 1

    return Q

class EllipticCurve:
    def __init__(self, p, a, b, n):
        self.p = p
        self.a = a
        self.b = b
        self.n = n
